Personal Use Telecommunications Devices An authorized District employee may confiscate a personal telecommunications device, including a mobile telephone, used in violation of applicable campus rules.
A confiscated personal telecommunications device shall be released for a fee determined by the Board.
If a personal telecommunications device is not retrieved, the District shall dispose of the device after providing notice required by law.
Other Electronic Devices Guidelines regarding other personal electronic devices shall be addressed in the student handbook.
